description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Polgahanga, Udunuwara D/S Division, Kandy District   -  Cad. Map No.  320240
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, locations, and ownership details. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" and focuses on land registration and title settlement, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
